seo.description: See Broward’s 2026-2027 school calendar, official PDF, six early-release days, Thanksgiving and spring breaks, winter return and final report-card dates.

hero.heading: Broward School Calendar 2026-2027
hero.mobileDescription: Aug. 10-May 28. Students return Jan. 5 after winter break and Mar. 29 after spring break. Six early-release days; final K-11 cards June 10.
hero.desktopDescription: Broward’s student year runs August 10, 2026-May 28, 2027. Six early-release dates include the last day. Winter classes resume January 5; spring classes resume March 29. Grade 12 final cards are issued May 24, with K-11 cards following June 10.

editorialSummary.heading: Plan pickup days and the two final report-card dates
paragraphs: Broward’s final student day, May 28, comes before Memorial Day and has early release. Final report cards follow different schedules: Grade 12 cards are issued May 24, while kindergarten through Grade 11 cards are issued June 10. The June date is for report distribution after classes have ended. Families with children in different grades will need both dates when checking final results.

There are six early-release days across the year. Five also serve as possible severe-weather make-up dates, so keep an eye on district messages if a storm disrupts classes. February 12 is the remaining shortened date. The calendar gives the dates without campus pickup times; use your school’s dismissal notice before arranging transportation or afternoon care.

For longer trips, Thanksgiving closes the full November 23-27 school week. Winter break ends January 1, but the January 4 employee planning day means students return January 5. In March, a standalone closure on March 10 is followed by regular school days before the March 19 planning day and March 22-26 spring break. Classes resume March 29. Those two March closures are separate stretches.

March 10 is a separate closure before the later spring break

faqs.question: What are Broward’s first and last school days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Classes begin Monday, August 10, 2026 and end Friday, May 28, 2027. The last day has early release. August 3-7 is employee planning before students start.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break, and when do classes resume?
faqs.answer: Students are off Monday, November 23 through Friday, November 27, 2026. The scheduled return is Monday, November 30. Including the surrounding weekends, that is nine consecutive days without classes.

faqs.question: Is January 4 a school day after winter break?
faqs.answer: No. Winter break runs December 21, 2026-January 1, 2027, and Monday, January 4 is an employee planning day. Students return Tuesday, January 5 for the start of the third quarter.

faqs.question: How long are students off for spring break?
faqs.answer: The named spring break is March 22-26, 2027. Friday, March 19 is a separate employee planning day, so students have no classes from March 19 through March 28, including both weekends. The fourth quarter starts Monday, March 29.

faqs.question: Is March 10 part of spring break?
faqs.answer: No. Wednesday, March 10 is a separate Schools Closed date. March 11-12 and March 15-18 remain scheduled school days; March 18 has early release. The longer student break starts with planning on March 19.

faqs.question: Which days have early release in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The six dates are October 9 and December 18, 2026, and February 12, March 18, April 30 and May 28, 2027. Students attend on these dates. Confirm the pickup time with your school because the annual calendar does not give bell times.

faqs.question: What are Broward’s severe-weather make-up dates?
faqs.answer: The published list is October 9 and December 18, 2026, and March 18, April 30 and May 28, 2027. Each is already an early-release school day. A BCPS update would explain any weather-related schedule change; none of these dates is listed as a student holiday.

faqs.question: Which teacher planning days mean no school during the student year?
faqs.answer: The in-year employee planning days are October 12 and November 3, 2026, and January 4 and March 19, 2027. Students have no classes on those four dates. Planning before August 10 and after May 28 falls outside the student year.

faqs.question: Do students have school on Election Day, November 3?
faqs.answer: No. Tuesday, November 3, 2026 is an employee planning day with no school for students. Classes are scheduled to resume Wednesday, November 4.

faqs.question: Are there September holidays after school starts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Schools and administrative offices are closed Monday, September 7 and Monday, September 21, 2026. Both create three-day weekends, with classes scheduled to resume September 8 and September 22 respectively.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a day off for students?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wednesday, November 11, 2026 is marked Schools and Administrative Offices Closed. November 10 is an interim-report date, and November 12 is a scheduled school day.

faqs.question: Are classes held on Martin Luther King Jr. Day and Presidents Day?
faqs.answer: The calendar marks Monday, January 18 and Monday, February 15, 2027 as Schools and Administrative Offices Closed. Students do not have classes on either date.

faqs.question: When are interim reports issued?
faqs.answer: The four interim-report dates are September 9 and November 10, 2026, and February 16 and April 28, 2027. Report distribution does not change the school schedule on those dates.

faqs.question: When are the first three quarterly report cards issued?
faqs.answer: Report cards are issued October 21, 2026, January 13, 2027 and April 6, 2027. Final fourth-quarter cards have separate dates for Grade 12 and K-11.

faqs.question: When do seniors receive their final report cards?
faqs.answer: Grade 12 final report cards are issued Monday, May 24, 2027. That is a reporting date, not a published graduation ceremony or a separate districtwide last day for seniors.

faqs.question: When are final K-11 report cards issued after school ends?
faqs.answer: Kindergarten through Grade 11 final report cards are issued Thursday, June 10, 2027. Classes end May 28, so June 10 does not mean students return for another school day. Follow your school’s distribution instructions.

faqs.question: When do Broward’s grading quarters begin?
faqs.answer: The synopsis starts the four quarters on August 10 and October 13, 2026, and January 5 and March 29, 2027. October 13, January 5 and March 29 are the returns after the adjoining planning days or breaks.

faqs.question: How many school days does the calendar contain?
faqs.answer: Broward’s quarterly schedule adds up to 180 student days. Teacher planning days and school holidays are excluded; the six early-release dates still count as school days.

faqs.question: Does the school year continue after Memorial Day?
faqs.answer: No. The last student day is Friday, May 28, 2027, before Memorial Day on May 31. The June 1 employee planning entry is for staff, while June 10 remains relevant for K-11 final report cards.

faqs.question: Are graduation dates and individual exam schedules included?
faqs.answer: The supplied annual color calendar does not list graduation ceremonies or a course-by-course exam timetable. Check the high school’s notices for ceremony dates, rehearsals and exams; May 28 alone does not establish those arrangements.

faqs.question: Where is the official Broward calendar, including an accessible version?
faqs.answer: The BCPS district calendar page links the color PDF, a black-and-white version, an accessible calendar and a written synopsis for 2026/27. Check that page and district announcements for later changes, especially after a weather closure.

editorialSummary.heading: A March spring break and a separate April break
paragraphs: Broward’s 2027-2028 year starts on a Tuesday, August 10, and runs through May 31. The first semester ends December 17, before winter break, and semester exams are to take place before that break. The calendar gives 84 days for the first semester and 96 for the second. Both semesters include shortened school days, so an early-release date still belongs on the attendance schedule.

Spring break falls March 13-17. The following Monday, March 20, is teacher planning, which keeps students out until Tuesday, March 21. A separate April closure begins Friday, April 14 and continues through the April 17 planning day. Classes are scheduled to resume April 18. There are school days between these two breaks; families should treat them as separate travel windows.

February 14 is an early-release day for A Day of Service and Love. The other five shortened dates also appear on the severe-weather make-up list. Follow district notices if weather affects those plans. This edition does not give report-card or interim-report dates, and the May 31 last day does not establish a graduation ceremony date.

faqs.question: Has the 2027-2028 calendar been approved, even though the PDF says Option #1?
faqs.answer: Yes. BCPS announced approval of the 2026/27 and 2027/28 calendars on December 18, 2025, and links this file as its 2027/28 school year calendar. The retained Option #1 heading identifies the selected calendar.

faqs.question: What are the Thanksgiving break and return dates?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break is Monday, November 22 through Friday, November 26, 2027. With the surrounding weekends, students have nine consecutive days without classes. The scheduled return is Monday, November 29.

faqs.question: When do students return from winter break in January 2028?
faqs.answer: Students return Tuesday, January 4. The named winter break runs December 20-31, 2027, and Monday, January 3 is teacher planning. December 17 is an early-release school day before the break.

faqs.question: Does spring break include Monday, March 20?
faqs.answer: The named spring break is March 13-17, 2028. March 20 is a separate teacher planning day with no student classes. The PDF explicitly gives Tuesday, March 21 as the student return.

faqs.question: Is there another student break in April 2028?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, April 14 is a day off, and Monday, April 17 is teacher planning. Together with the weekend, that makes four consecutive days without student classes. Thursday, April 13 has early release; the scheduled return is Tuesday, April 18.

faqs.question: What are all six early-release dates?
faqs.answer: They are October 8 and December 17, 2027, and February 14, March 10, April 13 and May 31, 2028. These are school attendance days with an earlier dismissal. The annual PDF does not list pickup times.

faqs.question: Is A Day of Service and Love a school holiday in 2028?
faqs.answer: Monday, February 14 is an early-release day for A Day of Service and Love. Students are scheduled to attend. Schools can provide the activities and dismissal arrangements for their students.

faqs.question: Which dates may be used for severe-weather make-up?
faqs.answer: The PDF lists October 8 and December 17, 2027, and March 10, April 13 and May 31, 2028. All five already have early release in the published schedule. Check a later BCPS notice for any change; these entries do not create five additional days off.

faqs.question: Do students attend on October 11 or October 12, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. October 11 is marked Day Off, and October 12 is teacher planning. The preceding Friday, October 8, has early release. Students are scheduled to return Wednesday, October 13.

faqs.question: Is school closed on Friday, October 29, 2027?
faqs.answer: The calendar marks October 29 as a day off. It is a separate one-day closure later in the month, with the scheduled return on Monday, November 1.

faqs.question: Are Labor Day and Veterans Day student days off?
faqs.answer: Yes. September 6 and November 11, 2027 are marked paid holidays in the annual school calendar, with no student classes scheduled. November 12 is not marked as another holiday.

faqs.question: Which January and February holidays interrupt classes?
faqs.answer: After the January 4 return, Monday, January 17 is a day off. Monday, February 21 is a paid holiday with no student classes. February 14 has early release and remains a school day.

faqs.question: Does Memorial Day fall before the last day of school?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, May 29, 2028 is a holiday. Classes are scheduled on Tuesday, May 30, followed by the May 31 last day with early release. The holiday does not start summer vacation.

faqs.question: When do grading periods and the first semester end?
faqs.answer: The grid marks the first nine weeks ending October 8, 2027, the second nine weeks and first semester ending December 17, and the third nine weeks ending March 10, 2028. The student year ends May 31. Each of those dates has early release.

faqs.question: When will students take semester exams?
faqs.answer: The PDF says semester exams will occur before winter break. It does not assign individual exam dates or publish a May exam schedule. Use your school’s exam timetable for each course.

faqs.question: Are 2027-2028 report-card and interim-report dates available?

faqs.question: How many student days are planned for 2027-2028?

faqs.question: Does May 31 also give the high school graduation date?

faqs.question: Where can parents check the PDF and later schedule changes?
